//: Vercel serves this repository as static files. There is nothing to build,
so the build command exists only to write a sitemap carrying the domain
Vercel has just assigned — VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL is set during a
build. Without it the script writes a robots.txt with no Sitemap: line
rather than one naming a domain nobody owns.
The Node server is NOT running here. Vercel is serverless: there is no
long-lived process and no writable disk, so server/index.mjs never starts
and /api/* does not exist. The site detects that and falls back to the
browser-only mode it had before the backend was written. That is a real
product difference, not a rough edge — see DEPLOY.md.

headers.//: The Node server sends these itself. Vercel is not running it, so they have to be declared here or the deployed site ships with none of them.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; connect-src 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'
